missionPremise: Smart Files CC-done (WDLL `_inbox/2026-08-15_a_wdll_cc_done_l15.md`): files are file-shaped smart-file documents reached by `placed-on` edges in `smart_file_placements`; folder membership is never reconstructed from entityId (decision `_decisions/2026-08-15_file_set_edges_not_identity.md`). L1 store on cortex-api main `015b15d6246ea6af12b6b25daa69eae8a75fc61b` is applied; this lane adds serving routes, MCP tools, CC panel, and seed script.
completionPredicate: Operator opens `#panel=smart-files` on deployed CC; MCP tools list/read the same room; seed satisfies WDLL item 3 counts; RBAC denies anon on tenant-private; platform-internal readable with operator key.
scopeBasis: Items 2-7 only. Planner owns canary (1) and close (9). No payment SDK, no G-19/G-44/G-53, no smartcity-os, no atoms --apply, no brokerage edits.

input.scopeId: string (opaque scope id; may contain colons for site)

output.folders: array of { folderId, label, scopeType, scopeId, accessPolicy }
output.absence: null when folders exist; typed SmartFileAbsence when scope unknown

mcpTools.name: list_smart_file_folder_files

input.folderId: opaque folder target_id (never parsed into entityId parts)

output.files: array of file-shaped document summaries from placements join (entityId, title, accessPolicy, currentVersion, placementsCount)
output.absence: typed when folderId unknown or folder empty with positive absence row

mcpTools.countingRule: files.length = DISTINCT smart_file_documents.id via smart_file_placements WHERE target_type='folder' AND target_id=folderId

mcpTools.name: read_smart_file
mcpTools.output: SmartFileReadResult union (held | absent-*); accessPolicy enforced before return; attachmentUrl relative path only when held

output.placements: array of placed-on edges { targetType, targetId, placedAt, placedBy }
output.absence: typed SmartFileReadResult when document not held

placedOnReadPath: File list and placement list query `smart_file_placements` with target_type='folder' and matching target_id. Documents joined on document_id. NEVER filter smart_file_documents by entityId prefix matching folderId. One file in two folders = two placement rows, same document_entity_id.
recordPanePath: Non-file atoms are NOT smart_file_documents and MUST NOT appear in list_smart_file_folder_files. Record pane reads `smart_file_folder_records` (new serve table, migration 0081): folder_target_id → { recordEntityId, entityType, payload }. CC reuses AtomInspector row renderer on payload objects. MCP has no list-records tool in v1; CC calls cortex-api GET /api/smart-files/folders/:folderId/records directly (same accessPolicy gate).
pdfFetchPath: read_smart_file returns held.version.contentCid. Attachment stream: GET /api/smart-files/files/:entityId/attachment?version=N validates document+version exist and accessPolicy, then streams bytes from engine GET /v1/blobs/:cid (gate-front) OR seed-local object path keyed by cid. Route 404 when document gone even if blob exists (no unsigned parallel URL).
staleBackdatePlan: Sidebar surfaces freshness.stale from evaluateSmartFileFreshness (same class as county-manifest computedAt). Seed script accepts --backdate-computed-at ISO flag on one document; integration test asserts stale=true after backdate. CC shows STALE Pill when freshness.stale === true.
servingAdapter: Thin cortex-api routes in legacy-design-tools worktree calling existing smartFileStore + new smartFileServe query module. MCP legacyClient HTTP to LEGACY_BACKEND_URL /api/smart-files/*. No second document table; migration 0081 adds folder registry + folder record links only.
willNotDo: copy smart-file.contract.ts into hauska-mcp-server (wire types duplicated minimally; A-013 promotion is planner-owned)
